author: reek
body: Stage 2 of the proof system: value-level propositional equality with SYNTACTIC checking (no normalizer yet). Terms are names, applications, and constructor applications, represented via TypeCon/TypeApply/TypeVar and compared structurally by the PropEqTy unifier arm. Reflexive value equalities check and erase; the negative cases live in codex/test/errors/term-mismatch.
